title: Compare by Workflow
principle: Compare workflow coverage and integration, not unsupported superiority claims.
rows: Dedicated estimating tools may specialize differently
Project management suites may go deeper in their own domain
Finance/ERP systems may provide broader accounting depth
Dedicated BIM authoring tools remain specialized
General AI tools are broader but less project-specific
Discipline-specific engineering software may provide deeper specialist analysis
Takeoff + BOQ + Estimate + Project + Cost + BIM + AI
Point tools often require more handoffs
